description: Use when you already know a tool's URL (remote endpoint, website, docs), GitHub repo, package (npm:/pypi:/oci: or bare name) or registry name and need its Toolwork ID; returns IDs, not a setup snippet. To find what to use for a task, call search_tools instead. ID scheme: mcp:<registry name>, mcp:docker/<key>, api:<apis.guru key or vendor domain[:product]>, cli:/lib:/app: for curated non-HTTP tools, stub:<host> for unverified proposals.

query.description: anything: we detect URL, repo, package or name

name: resolve_tool
